statistic.tfr_description: The average number of children which would be born to a woman over her lifetime if she experienced the current age-specific fertility rates throughout her reproductive years.
statistic.ccf_description: The average number of children born to a woman of a given birth cohort by the end of her childbearing years. Unlike the total fertility rate, it counts births which actually occurred to a real cohort rather than combining one year's age-specific rates into a hypothetical woman.
statistic.mean_age_at_childbirth_description: The average age of women giving birth in a given year, across every birth order.
statistic.mean_age_at_first_birth_description: The average age of women at the birth of their first child in a given year.
